notes.C%lld: Court number on a tiny watch complication, e.g. C1
notes.R%lld/%lld: Round 2 of 6 on a tiny watch label, e.g. R2/6
notes.%lldW: Number of wins, tiny label, e.g. 3W
notes.+1 A: Button: one point to team A (watch)
notes.+1 B: Button: one point to team B
notes.LIVE: Uppercase badge for a match in progress
notes.Live: Tab title: matches being played now
notes.Golden point: Padel 'punto de oro': deciding point at deuce
notes.Mexicano: Padel format name; usually kept as is
notes.Americano: Padel format name; usually kept as is
notes.Mixicano: Padel format name; usually kept as is
notes.Draw: A tied match result (not a lottery draw)
notes.Random draw: Random pairing for the first round
notes.Match tie-break: Super tie-break to 10 deciding the match
notes.%@ vs %@: Two team names; keep the double spaces
Onboarding headline; keep exactly one line break, two short lines
Onboarding headline; keep exactly one line break
Onboarding headline; keep exactly one line break
Onboarding headline; keep exactly one line break
Onboarding headline; keep exactly one line break
Home headline; keep exactly one line break
notes.and: Joins two player names, keep surrounding spaces
notes.· full rotation: Appended to a rounds summary; keep the leading ' · '
notes.· full rotation needs %lld: Appended to a rounds summary; keep the leading ' · '
notes.D: One-letter abbreviation for a draw in a player's form line (like W and L in the standings)
notes.Form: A player's recent results (last five matches)
notes.Won: Spoken result of one match in a player's form line
notes.Lost: Spoken result of one match in a player's form line
notes.Wins: Sort option and column: number of matches won
notes.Match point: Banner on the watch scoring screen: the next point can win the match (tennis/padel term)
notes.Set point: Banner on the watch scoring screen: the next point can win the set (tennis/padel term)
notes.Last point: Banner: one point is left before the fixed points total is reached
notes.Match won: Short banner: the match is decided and waits for confirmation
notes.Point undone: Short confirmation after undoing a point on the watch
notes.Double Tap: Apple Watch Double Tap gesture (use Apple's localized feature name)
notes.Off: Setting value: Double Tap does nothing
notes.+1 %@: Double Tap option: add a point for the named team
notes.Score may be out of date: Live Activity: the Lock Screen score has not been refreshed for a while
